keyPhrases.text: received great reviews in its regional premiere
Williams' background in stand-up comedy is well suited to this kind of role
convincingly captures the chaos of Iraq
Staging the play in a large Broadway theater...does not work to the play's ultimate advantage

reasoning: Mixed-positive review with more praise than criticism. Acknowledges the play's intelligent writing and effective performances, but notes staging issues. The positive elements (Pulitzer finalist, suited performances, convincing drama) outweigh the single significant criticism about the venue choice.
